arabic_text: السَّلام عَلَيْكَ يَا أبَا عَبْدِ اللهِ ،
transliteration: al-salām ʿalayka yā abā ʿabdillāh
english_text: Peace be on you, O Abu Abdullah!

arabic_text: السَّلام عَلَيْكَ يَا ابْنَ رَسُولِ اللهِ ،
transliteration: as-salāmu ʿalayka yā ibna rasūlillāh
english_text: Peace be on you, O son of the Apostle of Allah!

arabic_text: السَّلام عَلَيْكَ يَا ابْنَ أمِيرِ المُؤْمِنينَ ، وَابْنَ سَيِّدِ الوَصِيِّينَ ،
transliteration: al-salām ʿalayka yā ibna amīr al-muʾminīn wa ibna sayyidi al-wasiyyeena
english_text: Peace be on you, O son of the commander of the faithfuls, the forebear of the successors!

arabic_text: السَّلام عَلَيْكَ يَا ابْنَ فاطِمَةَ سَيِّدَةِ نِساءِ العالَمِينَ ،
transliteration: al-salām ʿalayka yā ibna fāṭimah al-zahrāʾ sayyidati nisāʾ al-ʿālamīn
english_text: Peace be on you, O son of Fatimah, the choicest among the women of the worlds!

arabic_text: السَّلام عَلَيْكَ يَا ثَارَ اللهِ وابْنَ ثارِهِ وَالْوِتْرَ المَوْتُورَ ،
transliteration: as-salāmu ʿalayka yā thāra allahi wa-ibna thārihi wal-witr al-mawtūra
english_text: Peace be on you, O the select, surpassing, chosen in preference over all good of Allah, and son of Allah's (such) good.

arabic_text: السَّلام عَلَيْكَ وَعَلَى الأرواحِ الّتي حَلّتْ بِفِنائِكَ ،
transliteration: al-salāmu ʿalayka wa ʿalā al-arwāḥi allatī ḥallat bifināʾika
english_text: Peace be on you, who was martyred while fighting heroically in the cause of Allah, the son of Allah's fearless warrior, you were isolated and had been attacked with a vengeance!

arabic_text: وَأنَاخَتْ بِرحْلِك
transliteration: wa anaakhtu bi rahlik
english_text: Peace be on you and on those souls who had gathered in your camp, and strided along with you, in your journey.

arabic_text: عَلَيْكُمْ مِنّي جَميعاً سَلامُ اللهِ أبَداً ما بَقِيتُ وَبَقِيَ الليْلُ وَالنَّهارُ.
transliteration: ʿalaykum minnī jamīʿan salāmu allāhi abadan mā baqītu wa baqiya al-laylu wa al-nahāru
english_text: I pray and invoke Allah to keep all of you tranquil and restful, for ever; so far I am alive, this is my prayer, and till nights and days follow each other.

arabic_text: يَا أبَا عَبْدِ اللهِ ،
transliteration: yā aba ʿabdillāh
english_text: O Abu Abdullah!

arabic_text: لَقَدْ عَظُمَتِ الرَّزِيَّةُ ، وجَلّتْ وعَظُمَتْ المُصِيبَةُ بِكَ عَلَيْنا وَعَلَى جَمِيعِ أهْلِ الإسلام ، وَجَلَّتْ وَعَظُمَتْ مُصِيبَتُكَ فِي السَّمَوَاتِ عَلَى جَمِيعِ أهْلِ السَّمَوَاتِ ،
transliteration: laqad ʿaẓumatir-razīya, wa jal-lat waʿaẓumatil-muṣība bika ʿalayna wa ʿala jamiʿi ahlil-islam wa jal-lat waʿaẓumat muṣībatuka fī al-sama-wāti ʿalā jamiʿi ahl al-sama-wāti
english_text: unbearable is the sorrow, nerve-racking is the agony, you put up with, for us and for all the (true) Muslims, crimes committed against you also shocked and unnerved the dwellers of the heavens, one and all.

arabic_text: فَلَعَنَ اللهُ اُمَّةً أسَّسَتْ أساسَ الظُّلْمِ وَالجَوْرِ عَلَيْكُمْ أهْلَ البَيْتِ ،
transliteration: fala'ana allahumma ummatan assasat asasa alththulmi waljawri 'alaykum ahla albayti
english_text: May Allah condemn and damn the people who laid the basis and set up the groundwork, to wander astray and turn aside from not only you and your family but to take liberties and bear hard upon you.

arabic_text: وَلَعَنَ اللهُ اُمَّةً دَفَعَتْكُمْ عَنْ مَقامِكُمْ وَأزالَتْكُمْ عَنْ مَراتِبِكُمُ الّتِي رَتَّبَكُمُ اللهُ فِيها ،
transliteration: wa laʿana allāhu ummatan dafʿatkum ʿan maqāmikum wa'azalat-kum 'an maratibikum allati rattabakum allahu fiha
english_text: May Allah condemn and damn the people who tried to obscure and deny your office and status, willfully neglected your rank and class Allah had made know in clear terms.

arabic_text: وَلَعَنَ اللهُ اُمَّةً قَتَلَتْكُمْ ،
transliteration: wa laʿana allah ummatan qatalatkum
english_text: May Allah condemn and damn the people who killed you.

arabic_text: وَلَعَنَ اللهُ الْمُمَهِّدِينَ لَهُمْ بِالتَّمْكِينِ مِنْ قِتالِكُمْ ،
transliteration: wa laʿan allāhu al-mumahhidīna lahum bi-al-tamkīni min qitālikum
english_text: May Allah condemn and damn the abettors who instigated and had a part in your murder.

arabic_text: بَرِئْتُ إلى اللهِ وَإلَيْكُمْ مِنْهُمْ وَمِنْ أشْياعِهِمْ وَأتْباعِهِمْ وَأوْلِيائِهِمْ.
transliteration: bariʾtu ila allahi wa ilaykum minhum wa min ashya'ihim wa atbā'ihim wa awliyā'ihim
english_text: I turn to you and Allah, away from them, their henchmen, their followers and their friends,

arabic_text: يَا أبَا عَبْدِ اللهِ ، إنِّي سِلْمٌ لِمَنْ سالَمَكُمْ ، وَحَرْبٌ لِمَنْ حارَبَكُمْ وَوليٌ لِمَنْ والاكُم
transliteration: yā abā ʿabdillāh 'innī silmun liman salamakum wa ḥarbun liman ḥārabakum wa waliyun liman walakum
english_text: O Abu Abdullah, I make peace with those who make their peace with you, I make war on those who go to war against you, I am his friend who is a friend of yours,

arabic_text: وعدوٌّ لِمَنْ عَاداكُمْ إلى يَوْمِ القِيامَةِ ،
transliteration: waʿdawwun liman ʿadākum ilā yawm al-qiyāmah
english_text: And Iam his enemy who shows enemity towards you, till the Day of Judgement.

arabic_text: وَلَعَنَ اللهُ آل زِيَاد وَآلَ مَرْوانَ ،
transliteration: walaʿana allahu āl ziyād wa āla marwān
english_text: May Allah condemn and damn the family of Ziyaad and the family of Marwaan;

arabic_text: وَلَعَنَ اللهُ بَنِي اُمَيَّةَ قاطِبَةً ،
transliteration: wa la'ana allahu bani umayyah qatiban
english_text: may Allah condemn and damn the group and the tribe of Umayyah, one and all, altogether;

arabic_text: وَلَعَنَ اللهُ ابْنَ مَرْجانَةَ ،
transliteration: wa laʿana allah ibn marjana'h
english_text: may Allah condemn and damn the son of Marjaanah;

arabic_text: وَلَعَنَ اللهُ عُمَرَ بْنَ سَعْد ،
transliteration: walana allahu ʿumar ibn saʿd
english_text: may Allah condemn and damn Umar son of Saad;

arabic_text: وَلَعَنَ اللهُ شِمْراً ،
transliteration: wa laʿana allah shi*mran
english_text: may Allah condemn and damn Shimr;

arabic_text: وَلَعَنَ اللهُ اُمَّةً أسْرَجَتْ وَألْجَمَتْ وَتَهيّأتْ وَتَنَقَّبَتْ لِقِتالِكَ ،
transliteration: wa la'ana allahu ummatan asrajat wa aljamat wa tahiyyat wa tanaggabat liqitalika
english_text: may Allah condemn and damn the people who bridled the horses and errected the saddles for your martyrdom.

arabic_text: بِأبِي أنْتَ وَاُمِّي لَقَدْ عَظُمَ مُصابِي بِكَ ،
transliteration: bi-abi anta wa ummi laqad ʿazhuma musabbi bi-ka
english_text: I, my father and mother are at your disposal. Profound is my sorrow for you.

arabic_text: فَأسْالُ اللهَ الّذِي أكْرَمَ مَقامَكَ ، وَأكْرَمَنِي بِكَ ، أنْ يَرْزُقَني طَلَبَ ثارِكَ مَعَ إمام مَنْصُور
transliteration: fa-ʾasʾalu allāh al-laḏī akramamaqāmaka, wa-ʾakramanī bika an yarzuqanī ṭalaba ṯārika maʿa imām manṣūr
english_text: I beg Allah, who honoured you above others, to be generous towards me on account of you, and give me the opportunity to be with the victorious Imam, at the time of the final and decisive war against Allah's enemies.

arabic_text: مِنْ أهْلِ بَيْتِ مُحَمَّد صَلّى الله عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ.
transliteration: min ahli bayti muhammad ṣallā allāhu ʿalayhi wa ālihi
english_text: the descendent of Mohammad (blessings and peace be on him and on his children from Allah)

arabic_text: اللهمّ اجْعَلْني عِنْدَكَ وَجِيهاً بِالحُسَيْنِ عَلَيهِ السَّلام الدُّنْيا وَالآخِرَةِ مِنَ المقَرّبينْ .
transliteration: allahumma ij'alni 'indaka wajihan bil-husayn 'alayhi assalam ad-dunya wal-akhirati min-al-muqarrabīn
english_text: O my Allah make me attend to Your cause, sincerely, in every respect following in Husayn's footsteps, in this world and the hereafter.

arabic_text: يَا أبَا عَبْدِ اللهِ ، إنِّي أتَقَرَّبُ إلى اللهِ تعالى ، وَإلَى رَسُولِهِ ، وَإلى أمِيرِ المُؤْمِنينَ ، وَإلَى فاطِمَةَ ، وإلى الحَسَنِ وَإلَيْكَ بِمُوالاتِكَ ،
transliteration: yā ʾabā ʿabd allāh 'innī ataqqarabu ilá allāhi taʿālá, wa-ilá rasūlihi wa'ilā ʾamīr al-muʾminīn, wa'ilā fāṭimah wa-ilā al-ḥasan wa-ilayka bimuwālatika
english_text: O Abu Abdullah, I pray and invoke Allah to send blessings on you. I come nearer and seek greater intimacy with Allah, with His Apostle, with Ameerul Moomineen, with Fatimah, with Hasan and with you, with the help of your love and patronage,

arabic_text: ومُوالاةِ أَوليائِك وَبِالْبَرَاءَةِ مِمَّنْ قَاتَلَكَ وَنَصبَ لَكَ الحَربَ ،
transliteration: wa mūwālati awliyā'ik wa bil-barā'ati mimman qātalaka wa naṣaba lakal-ḥarb
english_text: cutting off every connection with those who took up arms against you and killed you.

arabic_text: وبالْبَرَاءةِ مِمَّنْ أسَّسَ أساسَ الظُّلْمِ وَالجَوْرِ عَلَيْكُمْ ، وَعلى أشياعِكُم وَأبْرَأُ إلى اللهِ وَإلى رَسُولِهِ وَبِالبراءِةِ مِمَّنْ أسَّسَ أساسَ ذلِكَ ، وَبَنى عَلَيْهِ بُنْيانَهُ ،
transliteration: wa bil-barāʾati mimmam assasa asāsa al-ẓulmi wal-jawri ʿalaykum waʿalā ashya'ikum wa ʾabraru ʾilā allāhi wa ʾilā rasūlih wa bil-barāʾati mimman asasa asāsa dhālika wa bannā ʿalayhi bunyānahū
english_text: I disconnect all links with those who, in the beginning, took the first steps to take liberties with and bear hard upon you, I take refuge with Allah and His Apostle (blessings of Allah be on him and on his children), free from the guilt of associating with those who laid the foundation for (your suffering), devised and carried out their corrupt plan of action,
